candidates.trace: After development capability admission, fixture parsing and an early existing-request/server no-op, seed_standalone_tactical_mission validates the raw mission_id with MissionId::new and discards the typed result. It then passes the same original string to the private StandaloneMissionFamily::from_mission_id, which calls MissionId::new again before splitting the validated mission coordinate and classifying animation, diagnostic or general. Diagnostic and animation tags additionally require a nonempty suffix. Existing source-only tests call the private family helper directly with valid and invalid raw strings; they were read, not run.
candidates.connected_repair: After discovering all production and source-only callers, retain the existing admitted MissionId across the private boundary or choose an equivalent owner that avoids discarding the already-validated value. Preserve native external String admission, the early existing-request behavior if intended, additional nonempty family-coordinate rules, exact diagnostic site distance and scene behavior, and the development capability gate. Do not conflate the separate mission-ID serde admission question or unrelated threat parse by a shared typed-value remedy.
candidates.discovery: partial; all callers, native retry policy, family aliases, independent lenses and exact historical aliases remain open

nonfinding.question: What does the selected 95e mission-roster source establish about enemy snapshot admission?
nonfinding.disposition: The core MissionEnemyRoster requires a nonempty, unique vector with u32-representable count. capture_enemy_roster constructs it from the live hostile context and compares its count to the current hostile group; MissionAuthority::capture retains the resulting exact IDs. The stored enemy_roster reconstructs the typed vector and requires each referenced Character row to exist, without rereading live group size. The selected tactical request and autoresolve then consume the stored roster. This is a bounded current source trace, not proof of life-state parity, all roster producers, SDK policy, execution or complete reconciliation.
nonfinding.predecessor: ASSESSMENT-L1-MISSION-ROSTERS.json is a separately attributed c100 trace; equal source bytes do not automatically promote it to 95e.
